title: Head-On: The Dot Is a Line
summary: A flashlight aimed straight at your eye shows one bright dot. Is that dot the whole thing? Stepping aside, the same ray of length 1, seen at the angle α between the line of sight and the ray, leaves a seen length sin α: 0, about 0.34, about 0.71 and 1 at 0°, 20°, 45° and 90° (a straight-projection model, computed on screen). Two unit arrows, where you look (o) and toward the light (a), agree by o·a = cos θ, which is 1 head-on; reading a particle as such a dot, a line seen head-on, is the book's interpretation (argued). Treated as a way of looking, the line through a = (3/5, 4/5) keeps only the part of an arrow along it: P = (1/25)[9 12; 12 16], v = (1, 0) drops its shadow Pv = (9/25, 12/25), looking again changes nothing, and P·P computed entry by entry over 625 returns every entry, P² = P (computed). Two lines are compared by the squared shadow: (3/5)² = 9/25 = Tr(P_o P_a). The one Lean citation: for a record measurement P with P_k = φφ* and a pure state ρ = ψψ*, the record weight equals ‖φ*ψ‖² and Tr(ρ P_k).
summary_zh: 手电筒正对着你的眼睛照，你只看见一个亮点。这个点就是全部吗？往旁边挪一步：同一根长 1 的射线，在视线与射线夹角为 α 时，看到的长度是 sin α，在 0°、20°、45°、90° 时依次为 0、约 0.34、约 0.71、1（按正交投影建模，屏幕上计算）。两支单位箭头——你看的方向 o 与朝向光源的方向 a——的相融度是 o·a = cos θ，迎面时为 1；把粒子读作这样一个迎面看去的线，是本书的解读（论证）。把过 a = (3/5, 4/5) 的线当作一种看法，只保留箭头沿线的部分：P = (1/25)[9 12; 12 16]，v = (1, 0) 的影子是 Pv = (9/25, 12/25)，再看一次不变；P·P 以 625 为分母逐项计算，每个元素都原样回来，P² = P（屏幕上计算）。两条线用影子长的平方来比较：(3/5)² = 9/25 = Tr(P_o P_a)。片中唯一的 Lean 引用：对记录测量 P，若 P_k = φφ* 且纯态 ρ = ψψ*，记录权重等于 ‖φ*ψ‖²，也等于 Tr(ρ P_k)。
